heterogeneity_flagged: DISINFORMATION_CRISIS and CYBER_PROPAGANDA — BOTH UNMAPPED. Their named mechanisms are INFORMATION-INTEGRITY / adversarial-deception failures (systematic false-information spread; bots, deepfakes, coordinated inauthentic behavior). None of the 9 Part XIV classes (all E/I-dynamics archetypes: excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation) expresses a fabricated-signal / adversarial-deception failure. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit. THIS IS THE KEY FINDING: Communication carries the SAME failure archetype Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL exposed (deception the E/I taxonomy cannot represent) — but at 2-of-5 (40%) of issues vs Finance's 1-of-6 (~17%). As the information domain, Communication is where information-integrity failure is the DOMINANT, not the exceptional, mode.

CYBER_PROPAGANDA — DOUBLE FINDING. It is both UNMAPPED in the failure-class map AND the only issue that FAILS the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test: its _authored circuit [TPJ, V1, NAcc, FPN] contains NO node from the REGULATORY_NODES set, so it is structurally lesioned (no inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm). Finance passed 6/6; Communication passes only 4/5. The two diagnostics agree here: the domain's adversarial-information issue is also its structurally-broken circuit.

TELECOM_FAILURE — classed GATING_FAILURE on its explicit NODE cue (THAL 'gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation', which restates the class definition verbatim); its SUMMARY cue ('severing critical connections', authored CC 'backbone severed, isolating communities') points instead at DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS (network is the unit of failure). Divergence recorded, not resolved by guessing.

MEDIA_MONOPOLY — classed GATING_FAILURE on its canonical THAL node cue ('stuck-closed=starvation', read as starvation of signal diversity); the underlying economics (ownership CONCENTRATION, winner-take-all) is a LATERAL-INHIBITION / winner-take-all flavor that the 9-class taxonomy captures only obliquely. Divergence recorded.

CENSORSHIP_OVERREACH — classed GATING_FAILURE on the OVER-gating pole (vlPFC 'over-suppress', dACC overfires flagging legitimate expression). Note the 9 classes contain a loss-of-inhibitor archetype (DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME) but NO dedicated excess-inhibition archetype; gate-stuck-closed→starvation (of legitimate speech) is the closest grounded representation.

All three grounded issues collapse to ONE class (GATING_FAILURE). This clustering is itself a finding: Communication's dynamical (non-integrity) failures reduce to throughput/gate pathologies, while its DISTINCTIVE failures (disinformation, cyber-propaganda) are information-integrity and fall outside the taxonomy entirely.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Communication-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

TELECOM_FAILURE.communication_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Collapse or severe degradation of telecommunications infrastructure... severing critical connections"; authored CC[Hypo]: "Primary communication backbone severed, isolating communities from information exchange"
TELECOM_FAILURE.reasoning: The canonical node cue restates the GATING_FAILURE definition verbatim ('gate stuck closed -> starvation'): the routing relay stuck closed starves communities of information throughput. Strongest grounding of the set.
TELECOM_FAILURE.note: DIVERGENCE: the SUMMARY cue ('severing critical connections', 'isolating communities') and the network-cascade of authored nodes (CC/FPN/FEF/CBLM all going hypo together) read as DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS (losing input disables distant regions; the network is the unit of failure). Classed on the explicit node cue (gating), with the deafferentation flavor flagged, not resolved by guessing.

CENSORSHIP_OVERREACH.subtype: OVER-gating pole -> starvation of legitimate expression
CENSORSHIP_OVERREACH.communication_text: canonical circuit vlPFC[Hyper]: "response-inhibition / stop — over-suppress"; authored dACC[Hyper]: "Regulatory conflict detection overfires, flagging legitimate expression as violations"; authored vlPFC[Hyper]: "Excessive message filtering prevents authentic organizational communication"; summary: "Excessive governmental or institutional suppression of legitimate speech"
CENSORSHIP_OVERREACH.reasoning: Over-active stop/filter (the brake stuck ON) closes the gate on legitimate speech, starving public discourse of it — the OVER-gating direction of GATING_FAILURE (gate stuck closed -> starvation).
CENSORSHIP_OVERREACH.note: TAXONOMY EDGE-CASE: the 9 classes contain a LOSS-of-inhibitor archetype (DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME) but NO dedicated EXCESS-inhibition archetype. Censorship is the exact opposite of disinhibition; gate-stuck-closed -> starvation is the closest grounded representation of hyper-suppression. Recorded rather than force-fit into DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (which would invert the mechanism).

MEDIA_MONOPOLY.communication_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Concentration of media ownership in few hands, reducing diversity of voices, editorial independence"; authored A1[Altered]: "Broadcasting channels deliver uniform messaging, reducing signal diversity"
MEDIA_MONOPOLY.reasoning: Same canonical THAL 'stuck-closed=starvation' node cue as TELECOM_FAILURE; read here as starvation of the diverse-signal channel (uniform messaging, reduced diversity of voices) = GATING_FAILURE.
MEDIA_MONOPOLY.note: DIVERGENCE: the underlying economics — ownership CONCENTRATION, winner-take-all dominance — is structurally a LATERAL-INHIBITION / winner-take-all pathology (one active unit suppresses its neighbors). The 9-class taxonomy has no dedicated 'pathological winner-take-all' class; the effect is captured only obliquely via the diversity-starvation reading. Flagged.

DISINFORMATION_CRISIS.reason: Issue text names an INFORMATION-INTEGRITY mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
DISINFORMATION_CRISIS.communication_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hypo]: "conflict/error monitor — noise-chase"; summary: "Systematic spread of false or misleading information through media channels, social platforms, and state actors, undermining public trust"; authored NAcc[Hyper]: "Social media reward loops amplify sensational falsehoods faster than corrections can propagate"
DISINFORMATION_CRISIS.reasoning: 'False or misleading information', 'sensational falsehoods' describe a fabricated-content / information-integrity failure: the SIGNAL ITSELF is corrupt, not the dynamics that carry it. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses fabricated-content or deception. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline. (Direct analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.)
DISINFORMATION_CRISIS.note: KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING #1. In an information domain the fabricated-signal failure is not exceptional; it is a leading mode. The neuro-substrate E/I taxonomy structurally cannot represent it.

CYBER_PROPAGANDA.reason: Issue text names an ADVERSARIAL information-integrity mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
CYBER_PROPAGANDA.communication_text: canonical circuit TPJ[Hypo]: "temporoparietal junction — social attribution & reorienting — mindblindness"; summary: "Coordinated online influence campaigns using bots, deepfakes, and algorithmic manipulation to shape public opinion and destabilize societies"; authored V1[Altered]: "Deepfake visual media undermines trust in photographic evidence"
CYBER_PROPAGANDA.reasoning: Bots, deepfakes, coordinated inauthentic behavior are ADVERSARIAL FABRICATION — an actor deliberately injecting counterfeit signal. This is the deception archetype (like FRAUD_SCANDAL / DISINFORMATION_CRISIS), outside the dynamical 9-class taxonomy. The TPJ 'mindblindness' node cue describes a hypo-function of social attribution, but the ISSUE as a whole is defined by adversarial fabrication; classing on the node cue alone would misrepresent it. Marked UNMAPPED.
CYBER_PROPAGANDA.note: KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING #2 + DOUBLE FINDING. CYBER_PROPAGANDA is ALSO the sole issue that FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (see incomplete_circuit_diagnostic): its authored circuit has no regulatory/feedback arm. Both diagnostics converge on the same issue.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against communication.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS 4/5, FAIL 1. CYBER_PROPAGANDA is INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT — its authored circuit [TPJ, V1, NAcc, FPN] contains NO node from REGULATORY_NODES, so it is a bare driver/relay set with no inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm. This DIFFERS from Finance (6/6 pass) and Energy (6/6 pass): Communication is the first audited domain with a structurally-lesioned authored circuit. NOTE: three issues (TELECOM_FAILURE, CENSORSHIP_OVERREACH, MEDIA_MONOPOLY) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (THAL; vlPFC; THAL) that are NOT in REGULATORY_NODES and would fail the test canonical-only; their _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner.

DISINFORMATION_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is dACC[Hypo] — dACC IS in REGULATORY_NODES, so this issue passes even canonical-only.

TELECOM_FAILURE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] (a gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT canonical-only; _authored supplies CBLM (forward-model error-correct).

CENSORSHIP_OVERREACH.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is vlPFC[Hyper]. NOTE: vlPFC is FUNCTIONALLY the inhibitory brake (response-inhibition/stop) yet is NOT in the hard-coded REGULATORY_NODES list (only vmPFC/dlPFC are), so the diagnostic would not credit it -> canonical-only INCOMPLETE; _authored supplies dACC. A REGULATORY_NODES coverage gap worth flagging.

MEDIA_MONOPOLY.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] (gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT canonical-only; _authored supplies OFC (outcome valuation).

CYBER_PROPAGANDA.observation: FAILS. TPJ (social attribution), V1 (visual), NAcc (reward drive), FPN (control-network view) are all drivers/relays; NONE is in REGULATORY_NODES. No inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm is authored. This issue is structurally lesioned AND unmapped in the failure-class map — the two independent diagnostics converge. Remediation would require authoring a regulatory partner (e.g. dACC conflict-monitor or vlPFC/vmPFC brake) into the circuit before it can be considered complete.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Communication mapping must preserve an analogous fast-transmission / slow-governance separation (e.g. real-time signal carriage vs slow editorial/regulatory correction), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
